contests.title: City Of Los Angeles — Measure SC
contests.scopeNote: Measure SC is submitted to the qualified voters of the entire Los Angeles Unified School District under adopted Ordinance188984 Section1 and the attested CF26-1100-S19 ballot resolution. The electorate is the school district, including its territory outside the City of Los Angeles. Original contest/question IDs and all held question records retained; no whole-city or school-board-subdistrict substitution.

provenance.sourceOrg: City of Los Angeles, Office of the City Clerk — adopted Ordinance188984
provenance.quote:
Section 1. A Special Election is hereby called to be held in the Los Angeles 
Unified School District on November 3, 2026, for the purpose of submitting to the 
qualified voters of the Los Angeles Unified School District a Charter amendment 
regarding the following subject: Campaign Finance Rules related to LAUSD Elections.

measures.questionText: LOS ANGELES UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT CAMPAIGN FINANCE RULES RELATED TO BOARD OF EDUCATION ELECTIONS. CHARTER AMENDMENT SC. Shall the Los Angeles City Charter be amended to clarify the campaign finance rules for Board of Education elections and allow for changes by ordinance?
